fields.headline: Adds $4.97M to Alten Construction's McClymonds High modernization contract
fields.summary: This amendment adds $4,970,159 to the design-build agreement with Alten Construction and HKIT Architects, raising the maximum from $6,962,252 to $11,932,411. The added work covers stormwater pollution prevention plan (SWPPP) compliance measures and subcontracting for early purchasing of materials and work on the McClymonds High School modernization.

25-1464.note: Corrected the vendor's name to Alten Construction, Inc. The official text misspells it as "Aten"; the item's title and the original 2023 agreement (23-0185) say Alten.
